messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: P1 egress errors detected in region us-west-4 (WUS4). Spike in 5xx to external egress peers. Auto-page sent to oncall-alex and SRE rotation. --probe-id: 8453

oncall-alex: got it, paging in. I’m pulling logs and real-time qps. tagging maria for net-level context.

maria-sre: on it. I see sustained 502/504s from our egress proxies to provider X peering (AS64500). Errors started ~06:12 UTC, correlates with increased retransmits.

kevin-net: confirm, seeing flaps on peering session. Route flaps from provider peer causing some BGP withdraws. Working with provider NOC to stabilize.

oncall-alex: severity P1 right? Impact: some hosted customers getting elevated 5xx on outbound connections; internal inference workers fall back but latency increases. Need immediate mitigation: divert egress to fallback-pop us-west-2.

luis-eng-runtime: recommend temporary traffic diversion rule. If we can reroute only traffic to provider X through us-west-2, that should reduce customer impact without full region failover.

oncall-alex: OK executing diversion. Steps for eng-runtime / infra:
```
# divert egress from WUS4 to USW2 for provider X
redwoodctl route set --region us-west-4 --peer provider-x --fallback-region us-west-2 --weight 100
# quick healthcheck after apply
redwoodctl healthcheck --region us-west-4 --peer provider-x
```

maria-sre: applying BGP dampening adjustments too, small window. provider NOC acknowledges and is investigating.

status-bot: Draft status page update suggested:
"We are investigating elevated 5xx responses from the us-west-4 region impacting outbound egress to a third-party peer. We are diverting affected traffic to a nearby fallback region (us-west-2) to restore connectivity. Customers may see transient increased latency while traffic shifts. ETA for mitigation: 15-30 minutes. Updates will follow."

jess-customer-succ: edit suggestion for severity and customer comms: add explicit list of affected services (hosted inference API, model downloads, hybrid connectors). Short customer-facing blurb: "We're diverting traffic to reduce errors; no action required from customers. We'll follow up when full stability is confirmed."

dan-product: can we include a short impact matrix for SLAs? ops-bot, can you surface affected tenant IDs and sample error rates?

ops-bot: Affected_tenants: ["tenant-239","tenant-1201","tenant-988"], current 5xx rate increased 18x vs baseline. (auto-note)

oncall-alex: routing change applied. Monitoring for error rate drop. Initial telemetry: 5xx down ~70% after diversion, tail latency up ~150ms for some paths. Continuing to watch.

maria-sre: provider reports partial hardware flapping on their edge. They estimate route stabilization in ~20-40 minutes. We should keep diversion until they confirm.

jess-customer-succ: customer notify draft (for affected account owners):
"Hello — we experienced elevated outbound errors from the us-west-4 region that affected external connectivity for some operations. We've rerouted traffic to a fallback region and error rates have dropped significantly. No action is required from your side. We'll notify you once the us-west-4 egress is fully restored. Apologies for the disruption."

oncall-alex: internal post-incident comms template (quick):
- What happened: peering flaps causing egress 5xx in WUS4.
- Mitigation: diverted traffic to USW2, BGP dampening, provider engaged.
- Impact: elevated 5xx for outbound calls for ~30 minutes for subset of tenants.
- Next steps: confirm provider stabilization, plan for revert traffic shift with canary, run a short warm cache pass.

luis-eng-runtime: when reverting, suggest canary rollout of 5% to WUS4 then 20% then full; watch for 5xx regressions and BGP withdraw events.

kevin-net: provider NOC updates: replaced flaky port, routes stable for last 90s. They will monitor 30m.

status-bot: Suggesting status page update 2: \"Mitigation in progress: traffic diverted to fallback region (us-west-2). Error rates decreasing. Continued monitoring.\"

oncall-alex: planning revert in 25 minutes if no spike. Will coordinate final status page + customer email. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
